method.scope: crates/engine/tests/**/*.rs in the review checkout, excluding helper-only source and non-test targets
method.screen: Search assertion comparisons with numeric thresholds, then inspect surrounding test functions and setup by hand. Treat only identical inputs/fixture construction and identical measured expression as candidates for lower/upper-bound implication. Preserve string/byte fixture literals; do not normalize them.
limitations: This is a bounded source review, not a Rust parser or behavioral-equivalence proof.
It screens explicit numeric comparisons; it does not infer equivalent behavior from different assertions, helpers, fixtures, or outputs.
Distinct body hashes are evidence of distinct text only, not distinct behavior contracts.

findings.disposition: No additional deletion was supported by this pass. The five TypeScript golden count smoke tests already removed in this branch are documented separately in typescript-lowering-01.json.

reviewed_groups.reason: The size assertion accompanies an exact pointer-size equality in the same test; no same-input threshold variants.
Distinct stream/image metrics and named protocol ceilings; they are independent invariants in larger transaction/backpressure tests, not competing thresholds for one result.
Same compiled fixture, but the two lower bounds measure different populations (reexports and computed type facts); neither implies the other.
Entity existence, elapsed-time bound, and owner count are different properties; owner assertions also include distinct-owner identity.
Different authority inputs and measured outputs; no same-fixture threshold variants.

The >=10 shared-golden assertion is the retained strongest check for the exact fixture group documented in the existing ledger. Other sites use separate stress fixtures or different metrics; the 2048-row and max-depth bounds protect distinct rejection and structural properties.

claim_limit: This review supports no further deletion from the inspected threshold patterns. It does not estimate total behavioral-contract count, prove other tests nonredundant, or imply any retirement target is unreachable.
